E2121

`--deep-checks={scope}` selects {selected}, and none of them holds a deep check.

What

`--deep-checks={scope}` selects {selected}, and none of them holds a deep check.

Why

A scope keeps the deep checks of the declarations it names, and these hold none, so it would keep nothing.

Fix

Drop it, or name a scope that holds a deep check: {holders}.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2121: tests/ui/deep_checks_unmatched_scope.stderr.

Error [jet.DeepCheckScopeHoldsNone]: `--deep-checks=run` selects `run`, and none of them holds a deep check.
 Why: A scope keeps the deep checks of the declarations it names, and these hold none, so it would keep nothing.
 Fix: Drop it, or name a scope that holds a deep check: no declaration of this program holds one.
